steps.objective: 完成「HTTP Cache：資料契約與分層建模」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for HTTP Cache: Data contract and layered model and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付 http-age.csv、新鮮度時間圖與304前後的metadata比較。
在交接件中加入「HTTP Cache：資料契約與分層建模」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：第1項研究的可複查條件：獨立得到current age320/640 s，核對freshness margin280/-40 s。 交接時須能核對：保存Date、Age、response time及resident time，明示初始age已做傳輸校正。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：保存Date、Age、response time及resident time，明示初始age已做傳輸校正。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver http-age.csv, freshness timelines and metadata comparisons around304.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for HTTP Cache: Data contract and layered model: Investigation 1 review criterion: Independently obtain current ages320/640 s and margins280/−40 s. Handover must also reconcile: Preserve Date, Age, response time and residence time and state that initial age is already transit-corrected.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Preserve Date, Age, response time and residence time and state that initial age is already transit-corrected. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。第1項研究的可複查條件：獨立得到current age320/640 s，核對freshness margin280/-40 s。 交接時須能核對：保存Date、Age、response time及resident time，明示初始age已做傳輸校正。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Investigation 1 review criterion: Independently obtain current ages320/640 s and margins280/−40 s. Handover must also reconcile: Preserve Date, Age, response time and residence time and state that initial age is already transit-corrected.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 第1項研究的可複查條件：獨立得到current age320/640 s，核對freshness margin280/-40 s。 交接時須能核對：保存Date、Age、response time及resident time，明示初始age已做傳輸校正。
steps.checkEn: Investigation 1 review criterion: Independently obtain current ages320/640 s and margins280/−40 s. Handover must also reconcile: Preserve Date, Age, response time and residence time and state that initial age is already transit-corrected.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 以 RFC 9111 的「HTTP Cache」作具名案例，研究以下介面或演算法：HTTP新鮮度依目前age及freshness lifetime比較；收取回應後不能重新從零計原始年齡。 本課從明示的離線資料建立證據，不要求接觸營運網路。
knowledge.textEn: Use RFC 9111 as the named primary case for HTTP Cache: Age, max-age and freshness. HTTP freshness compares current age against lifetime; receiving a response does not reset its original age to zero. Build evidence from explicit offline fixtures without accessing operational networks.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 保存Date、Age、response time及resident time，明示初始age已做傳輸校正。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve Date, Age, response time and residence time and state that initial age is already transit-corrected.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: HTTP新鮮度依目前age及freshness lifetime比較；收取回應後不能重新從零計原始年齡。
knowledge.textEn: HTTP freshness compares current age against lifetime; receiving a response does not reset its original age to zero.
